verdict.rationale: Conductor's core function is delegating tasks to coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) running inside its own workspaces, chat, and review flow. The docs say the agent can test repos, edit setup scripts, and run builds without step-by-step confirmation, and that agents keep working in cloud sandboxes after you close your laptop. Missing for 10: a first-party native assistant (the agents are third-party and need your own subscriptions or keys), and independent hands-on corroboration of how well delegation works beyond brief positive community remarks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Conductor lets you run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode in parallel.
The agent can test your repositories, update install and setup scripts, and run builds — without asking you to confirm each step.
Sandboxes spin up in seconds, and agents keep working after you close your laptop.
